sql_templates.name: SectorBreadthRotationWatchlist
sql_templates.template:
WITH latest_sector_breadth AS (
    SELECT sector, AVG(change_5d::numeric) AS avg_change_5d
    FROM breadth.sector_daily
    WHERE snapshot_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '20 days'
    GROUP BY sector
),
latest_stage2 AS (
    SELECT sector, COUNT(symbol) AS stage2_count
    FROM scores.stage_snapshots
    WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
    AND stage = 'STAGE_2'
    GROUP BY sector
)
SELECT lb.sector, lb.avg_change_5d, ls2.stage2_count
FROM latest_sector_breadth lb
JOIN latest_stage2 ls2 ON lb.sector = ls2.sector
ORDER BY avg_change_5d DESC, stage2_count DESC
LIMIT 10;
